regimes.name: Standard VAT research candidate
regimes.applicability: Taxable goods/services under the ordinary VAT regime.
conditions: IRD FAQ explicitly states 13%; commencement date and current fiscal-year amendments are unresolved.
Verify VAT registration, current turnover thresholds and mandatory categories.
Input deduction requires eligible business use, evidence and mixed-supply allocation.

regimes.name: Zero-rated supply classification
regimes.applicability: Only supplies legally qualifying for zero-rating.
conditions: IRD distinguishes zero-rated taxable supplies from exemptions and allows related recovery under applicable rules.
Confirm the current schedule and evidence, especially exports; an overseas customer alone is insufficient.

regimes.name: VAT exemption classification
regimes.applicability: Only supplies within the current exemption provisions.
conditions: Exempt supplies do not create ordinary related input-credit entitlement.
Review medicine, food and service classifications individually.

regimes.name: Business or company income-tax review
regimes.applicability: Entity/fiscal-year income tax; never a checkout tax.
conditions: Review the Income Tax Act and annual Finance Act for the selected fiscal year.

classification_questions: Which charges are meals, takeaway goods, catering, delivery, alcohol, tips or service charges?
How are discounts, deposits, vouchers and refunds treated at the relevant tax point?
Which mandatory-registration and mixed goods/service rules cover this outlet?
Which receipts are subscriptions, joining fees, donations, facility hire, food or admissions?
What is the club's legal form and which activities are commercial supplies?
Are dues, sporting access, dining, events and donations legally distinct supplies?
Which individual products are medicines, medical devices, supplements or cosmetics?
Does the business also provide clinical services, manufacture goods or import them?
Which items qualify under the current medicine/medical exemption schedule?
Does the business act as principal, agent, importer, exporter or manufacturer?
Which tariff/product codes and documentary evidence support each treatment?
Which current import/export registration exceptions and documentary tests apply?
Are sales on own account, consignment or commission, and is there a manufacturer appointment?
How are rebates, returns, free stock and cross-border transactions documented?
How are taxable and exempt purchases allocated through distribution and returns?
Which SKU classifications apply to the actual product mix?
Are there bundled goods/services, gift vouchers, used goods or imports?
Does PAN status differ from actual VAT registration and authority to charge VAT?
Are parts, labor, consumables, subcontract work and warranties separately supplied or bundled?
Does the workshop repair, manufacture, import or export goods?
Which threshold or compulsory-registration category applies to mixed parts and labor?

open_questions: The readable FAQ supports broad rate/input concepts but contains multiple historical fiscal-year examples. No threshold, filing deadline or withholding rate was copied into the seed.

The current VAT register lists a Finance Act 2082 consolidation and announces Finance Act 2083 materials. Linked current text and the older English PDF could not be retrieved; review the enacted FY2083/84 law.
All legal start/end dates remain null until the controlling text and Gregorian/Bikram Sambat date conversion are verified.
Resolve current product schedules, registration categories, input restrictions, excise/local levies and income-tax treatment with a Nepal-qualified reviewer.
